name: Andar Bahar
description: Andar Bahar is a traditional Indian banking game of pure chance from Bangalore, Karnataka. One card is dealt face up (house card); players bet on Andar (inside) or Bahar (outside). The dealer deals alternately to each pile until a card matching the house card's rank appears; that pile wins. Also known as Mangatha or Ullae Veliyae in Tamil.

history.origins: Originated in Bengaluru (Bangalore), Karnataka. Also known in Tamil as Mangatha or Ullae Veliyae.
timeline: 21st century: Popular in Indian online casinos and in Goa, Daman, Sikkim casinos
history.cultural: Popular in Indian casinos and online; pure chance, no skill.

setup.players: Dealer banks; any number of players bet
setup.dealing: One card dealt face up (house card). If house card is black, first card goes to Andar; if red, to Bahar. Then cards dealt alternately to Andar and Bahar until match.

rules.objective: Bet on which pile (Andar or Bahar) will receive the first card matching the house card's rank.
rules.gameplay: After house card is shown, players bet on Andar or Bahar. Dealer deals alternately to the two piles. First pile to receive a card matching the house card wins. Payouts: first-dealt pile ~1:1, other pile ~0.9:1. Optional second bet after first two cards if no match.
keyRules: House card determines which pile gets first card (black=Andar, red=Bahar)
First pile to get matching card wins
